default/30412.htm.text: Wind Sylph: I am a sylph, spirit of the west wind, the guide of the spring wind. Right now, I am relishing the wind of these parts. But I am disturbed if someone is next to me. So if you don't have any business with me, please continue your journey.

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30412-01.html.text: Wind Sylph: Nice to meet you, Elder of the magical world, manager of the elements. I am the Wind Sylph, messenger of Zephyr, guide of the storms. Have you come to me seeking the Tone of Wind, by any chance? The wind is an elusive figure, hard to grasp... Do you believe that you can get a note consi…
when: state STARTED; has items 2847; lacks items 2858,2861

links.text: "I will make a deal with you."

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30412-04.html.text: Wind Sylph: ...You have gathered all of them! You are faithful indeed... Even the wind keeps its promises. Take this Tone of Wind... Be careful, because it might blow away...
when: state STARTED; has items 2847,2858,2861; hasItemsAtLimit(player, HARPYS_FEATHER, WYRMS_WINGBONE, WINDSUS_MANE)

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30412-03.html.text: Wind Sylph: Is the wind blowing in your mind as well? Are all your memories blown away? 20 Harpy Feathers, 10 Wyrm Wingbone, and 10 Windsus Manes... If you do not bring these 3 materials, I will not give you the Tone of Wind.
when: state STARTED; has items 2847,2858,2861; !hasItemsAtLimit(player, HARPYS_FEATHER, WYRMS_WINGBONE, WINDSUS_MANE)

Q00228_TestOfMagus/30412-05.html.text: Wind Sylph: Are you taking good care of the Tone of Wind? That thing can be easily swept away, so hold on to it firmly. Once you lose it, you will never hear its beautiful melody again.
when: state STARTED; has items 2847,2858,2861; lacks items 2861

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30412-01.htm.text: Wind Sylph: I see you have come to find the Wind Token. The winds blowing here told me of your story. If you grant me one favor, I will happily give you the Wind Token. Not long ago, the wastelands Lizardman appeared in the Southern Wastelands, and it has been so noisy ever since that I haven't bee…
when: state STARTED; has items 1282; lacks items 1283,1285; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted())

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30412-02.htm.text: Wind Sylph: Is it that you do not wish to grant my request? All the noise gives me a headache ... Please, I beg you. Go to the Wasteland Lizardman. He is in the Southern Wastelands. The safest route for you will be to follow the road west of the valley and then head south.
when: state STARTED; has items 1283; lacks items 1284; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); !(hasQuestItems(player, FLAME_EARING) && !hasAtLeastOneQuestItem(player, BROKEN_BRONZE_MIRROR, WIND_BANGLE))

Q00404_PathOfTheHumanWizard/30412-03.htm.text: Wind Sylph: Thank you very much. Now I can meditate in peace. I was thinking of going to some other land because it was so noisy. As a token of my appreciation, I give you the Wind Token. Searcher of the wind, please do not forget your naive curiosity about materials. Curiosity always leads to inve…
